zh.title: 正式版 app 连测试版 station 时打不开 Station 和设置页
zh.body: 测试版 station 把上报的 emberRssBytes 字段改名成了 stationRssBytes（#4108），而正式版 app 还要求旧字段。workspace 里只要有一台这样的测试版 station，Stations 列表就解码失败，Station 页报错，设置页也刷不出来。正式版 station 不受影响。修复 #4137 让 station 同时发两个名字，已发到测试版 station 0.1.7379：把测试版 station 更新到这个版本或更新的版本即可恢复。

en.title: Stable apps connected to a test-channel station could not open Stations and Settings
en.body: Test-channel stations renamed a field they report, emberRssBytes, to stationRssBytes (#4108), while stable apps still require the old name. One such station in a workspace made the Stations list fail to decode, with errors on the Stations page and Settings not loading. Stable stations are not affected. The fix, #4137, makes stations send both names and is out in test-channel station 0.1.7379: updating the station to that build or later restores it.
